fixture.note: Explicit own-QA final-entry checkpoint only: mid-boss flags/defeated id bootstrap and validated clear positions. Normal constructor HP, invulnerability, damage, ammunition, original roster/world/spawning, stage duration and AI are preserved. No story-completion claim; no forced skill cooldown/attack state or enemy removal.

drain.note: Event-driven QA-owned cleanup bookkeeping only. Register each owned Promise before wait, or synchronously/asynchronously within a retirement that has not yet completed. Promise/thenable identity is deduplicated across this tracker: only its first accepted retirement runs. A fulfilled/rejected producer is not complete until its retirement (including any returned Promise and newly registered followers) finishes. Producer rejection alone is not a cleanup failure. Capacity is a lifetime entry bound, including completed entries; rejected capacity registrations are not observed and remain the caller's cleanup responsibility. The first wait uses one overall deadline with no polling and returns one fixed immutable report. Timeout does not cancel producer/retirement Promises; already accepted and later capacity-eligible followers continue best-effort, and later snapshots may differ from that fixed wait result. Work registered after an already completed wait cannot retroactively change its result. Reports retain primitive labels/status only, not values, raw errors, resources or Promises. This tracker performs no rendering, Game, storage or GPU operation.

note: QA-only actual normal mission02 final-entry fight on a fresh owned Renderer. Original art, full world/effects,60Hz advanceSimulation and interpolation are used; shooting and movement are explicit manual inputs. The normal boss cooldown and damage clock are never accelerated. RenderActor may be an interpolation copy; the observed rig state/75ms transition belongs to that exact actor. Derived saved-countdown progress is not an exposed continuous sampler clock. Tick traces/events/snapshots/both RNG are evidence, not cross-pass equality when manual input or rAF schedules differ. No FPS, natural-motion certification, audio-output, peak-memory or product-default claim. UI PNG copies remain after owned worker canvases are retired. Shared fire/explosion module images are awaited but never disposed by this job. Already-started native loads cannot be cancelled; failed partial player sibling loads/asphalt are explicitly unproven. One run per fresh page; no persistent storage read/write.
